$Comment: A ruin on legs that walks the plains. Roughly four times the height of a talus and nineteen times the block count.

StartAwake, Passive and no chase: it is awake from the moment it is built, it ignores anyone who has not hit it, and once hit it plants itself and answers whoever is in reach instead of following. Walking away from one works.

Every talus attack is turned off because it has no arms to perform them with. Stomp is all it has, lifting the nearest leg and putting it back down for about three times an arm smash. AttackRange is measured from the middle of a body seventeen blocks wide, so a shorter reach would only count targets already standing under the keel.
The crystals are on the legs rather than up top, so this is a fight on foot rather than a climb, and the model offers no route onto the island.
Seven crystals spawn and five kill it. The two spares mean a crystal on the far face of a leg, twenty blocks up twenty-five blocks of rock, does not have to be reached.

The footprint is the leg spread rather than the island, because the island overhangs and only the legs have to find ground: fourteen out on each corner against the spawner's four. Relief is wide because SpawnLevelToLowest stands it over the lowest ground in that footprint rather than the middle, and a leg can fold most of its length while only reaching two blocks past its rest length. Headroom is the whole forty-eight it stands, legs and island together.
